review_scope: Sky blue with pale ring/cuff bands and a tonal lower-right architectural panel bounded by a pale diagonal. Full source is an angled worn photo: visible city collage reduced to discrete source-ink contours, with cross/obstructions excluded. Enlarged heraldic cross outline, Portuguese cross, sponsors, badges and repeated manufacturer marks omitted; no invented hidden rear print. Colors are visual estimates. Original PNG fabric and alpha preserved; only the existing physical round collar is recolored.
limitations: Colors and placement are visual adaptations; original PNG round collar, fabric and folds retained.
